description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Layer 1 of 3 — call this FIRST when the user asks 这个月能同时做几件事 / 我能不能同时开三条线 / 该不该接新项目 / 手上还能加几件事 / 还想再开一条线行不行 / how many things can I take on right now / do I have bandwidth for one more project. Returns how many new fronts this segment can hold (1–3), the label, and the grounds — computed by a rules engine, not a model. It is a constraint, not a task list: it does NOT say what to do. For the next layer, call activity_window (which one to move) or month_brief (when). Public · local · no API key.
name: capacity_budget
title: Capacity budget · 承载力预算
